products.name: P198 Filcore SB (ExoHealer™)

products.specification_ru: 3 mL x 5 vials. Увлажнитель кожи, упругость и энергия. Антивозрастной, объёмный, сияющий эффект.

products.name: ULTRA CA Bio Stimulator
products.description: Ultra CA Bio Stimulator is a calcium hydroxyapatite (CaHA) collagen-stimulating injectable supplied as two 0.8 mL prefilled syringes, analogous to Radiesse in composition with CaHA microspheres (25–45 μm) suspended in a carboxymethylcellulose gel carrier. The CaHA microspheres provide immediate volumetric correction at the injection site, and as they gradually resorb over 12–18 months, the calcium ions stimulate fibroblasts to produce new collagen type I and III, elastin, and proteoglycans for lasting structural improvement. It is indicated for mid-face volume restoration, jawline contouring, hand rejuvenation, and skin biostimulation in patients with moderate to severe volume loss.
products.indication: Intended for professional protocols supporting volume restoration routines and collagen-stimulation objectives, designed for practitioners performing structured injection-based aesthetic care.
products.packaging: Box containing 2 pre-filled syringes of 0.8 mL each, supplied as a CaHA bio-stimulator for professional use.
products.protocol: Do not reconstitute; use directly from the 0.8 mL prefilled syringe with a 25G or 27G needle. Inject into the deep dermis or subdermal plane using a retrograde linear threading or depot injection technique; for facial biostimulation, dilute with lidocaine (4:1 ratio) for a more spreadable consistency. Inject 0.5–1.6 mL per zone; perform 1–2 sessions, assess at 4–6 weeks, then maintenance at 12–18 months.
products.description_ru: ULTRA CA — биостимулятор на основе гидроксиапатита кальция (стимулятор коллагена). 2 ea x 0.8 мл. Кальциевый (CaHA) филлер. Аналог FACETEM.

products.name: VOLASSOM calcium Bio Stimulator (Analogue of FACETEM)
products.description: Volassom Calcium Bio Stimulator (analogue of Facetem) is a calcium hydroxyapatite injectable containing CaHA microspheres in a gel carrier, supplied as two 0.8 mL syringes, formulated as a Korean-manufactured analogue of established CaHA bio-stimulators. The CaHA microspheres (average diameter 25–45 μm) act as a temporary scaffold providing immediate soft-tissue augmentation while simultaneously triggering neocollagenesis via fibroblast stimulation, with biological resorption of the calcium and phosphate particles over 12–18 months. It is indicated for facial volume restoration, skin biostimulation, jawline contouring, hand rejuvenation, and body skin tightening.
products.indication: Designed for professional protocols supporting collagen-stimulation routines and tissue-volume objectives, intended for practitioners performing structured injection-based aesthetic care.
products.packaging: Box containing 2 pre-filled syringes of 0.8 mL each, supplied as a calcium (CaHA) bio-stimulator filler.
products.protocol: Inject undiluted from the 0.8 mL prefilled syringe at subdermal or deep dermal depth with a 25G or 27G needle using retrograde threading or depot technique for contouring; for skin biostimulation, dilute with normal saline or lidocaine (3:1 to 4:1 ratio) and inject intradermally at 2–3 mm depth. Use 0.5–1.5 mL per zone; 1–2 initial sessions with 4–6 week review, then maintenance at 12–18 months.
products.description_ru: VOLASSOM — кальциевый биостимулятор (аналог FACETEM). Гидроксиапатит кальция. 2 ea x 0.8 mL. Кальциевый (CaHA) филлер.
products.specification_ru: 0.8 mL. Кальциевый (CaHA) филлер.

products.name: GOURI
products.description: GOURI is the world's first fully solubilized injectable polycaprolactone (PCL) biostimulator, delivering 210 mg/mL of liquid-phase PCL in a single 1 mL pre-filled syringe. Unlike microparticle-based collagen stimulators, GOURI's homogeneous liquid formulation spreads evenly through the dermal and subdermal planes after injection, creating a three-dimensional matrix that activates fibroblasts to generate new collagen, restore elasticity, and tighten lax skin across the full face. Indications include skin laxity, loss of elasticity, fine lines, and overall facial rejuvenation requiring a biostimulation approach.
products.indication: Suitable for professional aesthetic protocols using PCL-based skin support, designed for practitioners performing structured injection-based in-clinic treatment sessions.
products.packaging: 1 box containing 1 pre-filled syringe of 1 mL, supplied as a full-liquid-type PCL preparation for injection.
products.protocol: Administer via cannula or 30–33G needle into the deep dermis or subdermis at 1–4 mm depth, distributing the 1 mL syringe across 6 directional vectors on the face without the need for manual shaping. A single treatment session is standard; results develop over 4–12 weeks and last up to 12 months. A 1-month interval is recommended before combining with cross-linked HA fillers or PRP.
products.description_ru: GOURI — полностью жидкий PCL для инъекций. 1 коробка / 1 mL x 1 шприц.
products.specification_ru: GOURI. 1 коробка / 1 mL x 1 шприц. Полностью жидкий PCL для инъекций.

products.name: DERMAHEAL HSR
products.description: DERMAHEAL HSR is a comprehensive skin-rejuvenating mesotherapy solution containing 58 active ingredients, including 10 mg/mL (1%) non-cross-linked hyaluronic acid, 5 biomimetic peptides (Acetyl Decapeptide-3, Decapeptide-4, Oligopeptide-24, Tripeptide-6, Copper Tripeptide-1), 13 vitamins, 24 amino acids, 5 minerals, 4 nucleic acids, and epidermal growth factors. The peptide complex stimulates fibroblast proliferation and collagen and elastin synthesis, while the high HA concentration provides deep intradermal hydration. Indicated for dull, dehydrated, aging, or sun-damaged skin requiring intensive biorevitalization.
products.indication: Designed for professional protocols supporting the appearance of aged or dehydrated skin and refining the look of fine lines, intended for practitioners addressing overall skin quality.
products.packaging: Box containing 10 vials of 5 mL each, supplied as a rejuvenating and moisturizing meso solution.
products.protocol: Reconstitute each 5 mL vial and administer via mesotherapy gun or manual 30G needle into the superficial-to-mid dermis at 1–2 mm depth, delivering 0.02–0.05 mL per papule across the treatment area. Standard course: 1 session per week for 4 weeks, then 2 sessions per month for 2 months, followed by monthly maintenance. Use one 5 mL vial per session for the face.
products.description_ru: DERMAHEAL HSR Skin Rejuvenating — омолаживающий, разглаживающий морщины и увлажняющий раствор для восстановления стареющей, обезвоженной кожи. 5 mL x 10 vials.
products.specification_ru: 5 mL x 10 vials. Омолаживающий, антивозрастной и увлажняющий раствор для обезвоженной кожи.

products.name: DERMAHEAL SR

products.description_ru: DERMAHEAL SR — мощный антивозрастной и омолаживающий раствор (5 mL x 10 vials) на основе инъекционных нуклеиновых кислот. Предназначен для глубокой регенерации кожи.

products.name: ESRELLA TEA TREE ESSENCE
products.description: ESRELLA Tea Tree Essence is an injectable mesotherapy soothing solution enriched with antibacterial peptides, hyaluronic acid, and growth factors alongside tea tree-derived active compounds, formulated to target acne-prone, inflamed-looking, and unevenly pigmented skin. products.name: REPIDA CLEARNEST INTENSIVE FOAM CLEANSER
products.description: REPIDA Clearnest Intensive Foam Cleanser is a daily facial cleanser for acne-prone and oily skin featuring patented Anti Sebum P(HD) complex and 0.5% salicylic acid to control excess sebum and exfoliate congested pores. products.specification_ru: 150 мл, туба. Мягкая пенка для умывания для кожи, склонной к акне.

products.name: ACON DEEP CLEANSING FOAM

Broad-spectrum SPF 30+ is mandatory during daytime use.

Мощное средство от угрей, особенно комедональных (чёрные и белые угри). Нормализует обновление клеток кожи, предотвращает закупорку пор и высыпания. Для долгосрочного лечения акне.
products.specification_ru: 20 г. Местное средство от акне с салициловой кислотой 2%.

products.name: MELANOSA CREAM 4% [30g]
products.description: MelaNosa Cream 4% is a medical-grade depigmenting cream containing 4% hydroquinone, which inhibits tyrosinase — the rate-limiting enzyme in the melanin biosynthesis pathway — to reduce melanin production and progressively lighten hyperpigmented lesions. It is indicated for melasma (chloasma), post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation, freckles, senile lentigines (age spots), and solar lentigines caused by excess melanocyte activity in the epidermis. The 30 g cream format supports localized or zonal application across facial and body hyperpigmentation zones.
products.indication: • Melasma (chloasma) • Freckles • Post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation • Age spots / sun spots • Uneven skin tone due to excess melanin
products.packaging: Supplied as a 30 g tube per unit, as stated in the product specification.
products.protocol: Apply a thin layer to affected areas once or twice daily (morning and evening); avoid contact with periorbital and perioral mucosa. Mandatory broad-spectrum SPF 30+ sunscreen during daytime use to prevent photoreactivation of melanocytes. Standard treatment duration is 2–6 months; reassess at 8 weeks. Limit continuous use to 6 months; taper and incorporate alternative brightening actives for maintenance to reduce risk of ochronosis.
products.description_ru: MELANOSA CREAM 4% — крем направленного действия против гиперпигментации (30 г). Содержит 4% гидрохинона — эффективного осветляющего компонента. Целенаправленно осветляет тёмные пятна, мелазму и пигментные пятна.
products.specification_ru: 30 г. Крем против гиперпигментации с 4% гидрохиноном.

products.name: ALBENDAZOLE (Dewormer)
products.description: Albendazole is a broad-spectrum benzimidazole anthelmintic that selectively binds to parasite beta-tubulin, inhibiting tubulin polymerization and thereby causing microtubule disassembly, energy depletion via glycogen consumption, and death of susceptible intestinal and tissue-dwelling helminths. Each 400 mg tablet provides a single-dose effective against roundworm, hookworm, whipworm, and pinworm infestations, with extended dosing cycles used for tissue cestodoses including cysticercosis and echinococcosis. Supplied as 2 tablets per pack for a standard two-dose or single-dose deworming course.
products.indication: Intended for intestinal deworming use under appropriate clinician guidance and in accordance with locally applicable prescribing information and patient assessment.
products.packaging: Supplied as 2 tablets per pack, as stated in the product specification.
products.protocol: For intestinal nematode infections: 400 mg as a single oral dose, taken with a fatty meal to enhance absorption; a second dose may be given 2–3 weeks later for confirmed reinfection. For tissue parasite infections (echinococcosis, cysticercosis): 400 mg twice daily with meals for 28 days, followed by a 14-day drug-free interval, for a total of 3 cycles. Dosage, cycle number, and follow-up are determined by the prescribing clinician; not recommended in the first trimester of pregnancy.
products.description_ru: ALBENDAZOLE (антигельминтное средство) — 2 таблетки/упаковка. Альбендазол — антипаразитарный препарат для кишечного дегельминтизации. В Корее выпускается под разными торговыми марками; может быть предоставлен любой эквивалентный бренд.
products.specification_ru: 2 таблетки/упаковка. Антипаразитарный препарат для дегельминтизации.

products.name: D PANSEPTIC CREAM [30g]

The dual-active formula provides simultaneous microbial control and wound-bed moisturization, making it suitable for minor wound care in sensitive populations including infants and post-procedure skin. Indicated for minor cuts, abrasions, superficial burns, post-injection site care, and general antiseptic first-aid use.
products.indication: Designed as an antiseptic care option suitable for sensitive skin and children, including general minor injury aftercare within routine household first-aid practice.
products.packaging: Supplied as a 30 g tube per unit, as stated in the product specification.
products.protocol: Clean the affected area with water or saline; apply a thin layer of cream directly to the wound or skin surface 2–3 times daily; cover with a sterile dressing if clinically indicated. Suitable for use on sensitive skin and children. Avoid application inside deep wounds or cavities. Discontinue if rash, unusual sensitivity, or lack of healing progress occurs and seek clinical review.
products.description_ru: D-PANSEPTIC CREAM — антисептический заживляющий крем (30 г) с хлоргексидином гидрохлоридом (5 мг/г) и декспантенолом (50 мг/г). products.name: SCARDERM GEL [10G]
products.description: Scarderm Gel (10 g) is a topical scar-care gel combining Allantoin (promotes keratinocyte proliferation and scar tissue softening), Heparin (anticoagulant and anti-fibrotic that reduces collagen cross-linking in hypertrophic tissue), and Onion Extract (Allium Cepa, which inhibits fibroblast proliferation and downregulates TGF-beta signaling to flatten raised scars). The triple-active synergy addresses excess collagen deposition, scar vascularization, and tissue stiffness, making it effective across hypertrophic scars, keloids, post-surgical scars, burn scars, and injury-related scarring. This smaller 10 g tube is suited for localized facial or limited-area scar management.
products.indication: Designed to support routines aimed at softening and smoothing the visible appearance of scars and helping to maintain pliable, comfortable scar tissue over time.

Treatment should begin once wounds are fully closed; optimal results require consistent use for 3–6 months. Combine with silicone sheeting or compression therapy as clinically indicated for hypertrophic scars. Avoid application on open or infected wounds.

Уменьшает гипертрофические рубцы и келоиды, смягчает и сглаживает. Наносить 2-3 раза в день лёгкими массирующими движениями.
products.specification_ru: 10 г. Гель для смягчения рубцов: келоиды, послеоперационные, ожоговые и травматические рубцы.

products.name: RECLAN (PDRN SOLUTION)
products.description: RECLAN is a preservative-free polydeoxyribonucleotide (PDRN) solution supplied in 0.5 mL single-dose tubes; PDRN consists of low-molecular-weight DNA fragments derived from salmon sperm that activate adenosine A2A receptors, stimulating tissue repair, promoting angiogenesis, and exerting anti-inflammatory effects via the cAMP pathway. Though registered as an ophthalmic preparation for dry eye, PDRN's regenerative and anti-inflammatory properties have led to its off-label application in dermatology for skin hydration, post-procedure recovery, and periocular rejuvenation. Each single-dose tube ensures sterility and prevents preservative-related cellular toxicity.
products.indication: Intended for hydration and skin-care support within suitable practitioner-led routines, used under appropriate clinical guidance and in line with labeled administration.
products.packaging: Supplied as 0.5 mL x 30 single-dose tubes per pack, as stated in the product specification.
products.protocol: For ophthalmic use: instill 1–2 drops into the conjunctival sac as directed by the prescribing ophthalmologist or physician; discard unused portion after each single-dose application. For off-label dermatological use: apply topically or use for intradermal injection only under qualified medical supervision in strict accordance with the prescribing clinician's instructions. Adhere to single-dose handling and aseptic technique at all times.
products.description_ru: RECLAN (PDRN SOLUTION) — офиц. глазной препарат, применяемый off-label в дерматологии для восстановления и омоложения кожи. 0.5 mL x 30 туб. Безконсервантная регенерирующая формула стимулирует обновление клеток, восстанавливает повреждённую кожу, увлажняет и ускоряет регенерацию.
products.specification_ru: 0.5 mL x 30 туб. PDRN-раствор. Официально — глазной препарат; применяется off-label для восстановления кожи.

products.name: EYEOCOOL RENEW PDRN
products.description: EYEOCOOL Renew PDRN contains polydeoxyribonucleotide sodium (PDRN) at 0.75% in a preservative-free, single-dose format; PDRN's salmon DNA-derived polynucleotide fragments activate A2A purinergic receptors to upregulate cellular repair mechanisms, stimulate fibroblast proliferation, and suppress pro-inflammatory cytokines including TNF-alpha and IL-1beta. The single-use 0.5 mL vials eliminate preservative-associated cellular toxicity, making this formulation particularly compatible with compromised or post-procedure skin barriers. Used clinically for skin nourishment, periorbital hydration, and post-laser or post-microneedling recovery support.
products.indication: Suitable for inclusion within structured skin-care routines that are designed to support hydration, elasticity, and overall comfort within routine maintenance programs.
products.packaging: Supplied as 0.5 mL x 30 single-dose tubes per pack, as stated in the product specification.
products.protocol: Open a single-dose tube immediately before use; for topical skin application, apply the contents to cleansed skin and gently massage until absorbed, using once or twice daily as part of a routine skin-care regimen or post-procedure protocol. For any injection or peri-ocular clinical application, follow strict prescriber instructions and aseptic technique. Discard unused portion after each single-dose use; do not share between patients.
products.description_ru: EYEOCOOL RENEW PDRN — регенерирующий препарат (0.5 mL x 30 туб), обогащённый PDRN. Восстанавливает микроповреждения, снимает воспаление, стимулирует синтез коллагена. Питает кожу, повышает эластичность, возвращает здоровый и сияющий вид.
products.specification_ru: 0.5 mL x 30 туб. PDRN — мощный ингредиент для регенерации кожи.

products.name: MADECASSOL GEL [10G]
products.description: Madecassol Gel (10 g) is a lightweight, non-greasy topical gel formulated with Centella Asiatica extract (Madecassoside) as the active ingredient, which promotes fibroblast proliferation, stimulates collagen synthesis via TGF-beta1 upregulation, reduces hyaluronic acid degradation, and exerts anti-inflammatory effects on post-procedure and wounded skin. It is antibiotic-free and steroid-free, making it suitable for repeated use on sensitive, reactive, or recently treated skin without risk of antibiotic resistance or corticosteroid-related side effects. Indicated for post-laser, post-peel, post-microneedling, and post-injection recovery, as well as minor wound healing and scar management on the face.
products.indication: Designed for post-procedure skin-care routines and for inclusion in programs addressing the appearance of scars, burns, and general skin irritation comfort.
products.packaging: Supplied as a 10 g tube per unit, as stated in the product specification.
products.protocol: Apply a thin layer to clean, intact, or healing skin as needed throughout the day, 2–4 times daily, gently dabbing without friction. This smaller 10 g format is ideal for targeted facial post-procedure care. Begin application after active weeping or bleeding has ceased; use consistently until the skin is fully recovered. Combine with SPF 30+ during daytime use on healing skin.
products.description_ru: MADECASSOL GEL — успокаивающий восстановительный гель (10 г) с центеллой азиатской (мадекассозид). Идеально для заживления рубцов, ожогов, раздражений и кожи после процедур. Лёгкая, не жирная формула.
products.specification_ru: 10 г. Успокаивающий восстановительный гель с центеллой азиатской (мадекассозид).

products.name: MADECASSOL GEL [20G]
products.description: Madecassol Gel (20 g) contains the same Centella Asiatica (Madecassoside) active as the 10 g formulation, promoting collagen synthesis, fibroblast activity, and anti-inflammatory tissue repair without antibiotics or steroids. The larger 20 g tube accommodates wider treatment areas, extended post-procedure courses, or multi-zone simultaneous application including full-face laser or peel recovery. Indicated for sensitive and post-procedure skin, minor wounds, redness, irritation, and scar-area conditioning.
products.indication: • Sensitive / irritated skin • Post-procedure care (laser, peeling, MTS) • Minor wounds (non-infected) • Redness and skin recovery
products.packaging: Supplied as a 20 g tube per unit (larger format), as stated in the product specification.
products.protocol: Apply a thin layer 1–2 times daily to clean skin; gently dab onto treated areas without friction and allow to absorb before applying sunscreen or other topicals. Start once active oozing has resolved. The 20 g size is suited for full-face application or multi-session treatment courses requiring higher product volume. Pair with broad-spectrum SPF 30+ during daytime recovery.
products.specification_ru: 20 г. Большая туба.

products.name: MELATONING CREAM 2%
products.description: Melatoning Cream 2% is a skin-brightening topical cream combining Melatonin — an endogenous neurohormone and potent antioxidant that modulates melanocyte stimulating hormone (MSH) receptor activity and scavenges reactive oxygen species that upregulate melanogenesis — and Niacinamide, which inhibits melanosome transfer from melanocytes to keratinocytes via suppression of PAR-2 receptor signaling. The dual-mechanism formulation addresses both melanin production and distribution, suitable for all skin types including sensitive skin. Indicated for melasma, solar lentigines, post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation, and diffuse uneven skin tone.
products.indication: Designed for routines targeting the visible appearance of hyperpigmentation, localized dark spots, and uneven skin tone within structured daily skin-care programs.
products.packaging: Supplied as a 30 g tube per unit, as stated in the product specification.
products.protocol: Apply a pea-sized amount to clean, dry skin twice daily (morning and evening), massaging until fully absorbed; apply broad-spectrum SPF 30+ as the final morning step to prevent UV-induced melanogenesis counteracting treatment efficacy. Allow 8–12 weeks of consistent daily use for clinical assessment of depigmenting response. Avoid simultaneous use with products containing high-concentration retinoids or exfoliating acids without clinician guidance.
products.description_ru: MELATONING CREAM 2% — осветляющий крем (30 г) с мелатонином и ниацинамидом. Устраняет гиперпигментацию, тёмные пятна и неровный тон кожи. Подходит для всех типов кожи.
products.specification_ru: 30 г. Осветляющий крем с мелатонином и ниацинамидом.

products.name: EGF ACTIVE VITAL CREAM [20mL]
products.description: PRO-CALM EGF Active Vital Cream is a 20 mL regenerating moisturizer formulated with high-purity human Epidermal Growth Factor (sh-Oligopeptide-1), which binds to EGF receptors (EGFR) on keratinocytes and fibroblasts to stimulate cell division, accelerate epidermal renewal, and support dermal collagen deposition. The cream is designed for post-procedure barrier recovery, addressing impaired skin following laser resurfacing, chemical peels, or microneedling by accelerating re-epithelialization and reducing downtime. Indicated for sensitive, compromised, post-procedure, and aging skin requiring active cellular repair support.
products.indication: Designed for routines aimed at supporting skin elasticity, the visible appearance of fine lines, and overall skin renewal as part of regular structured maintenance.
products.packaging: Supplied as a 20 mL tube per unit, as stated in the product specification.
products.protocol: Apply a pea-sized amount to thoroughly cleansed face and neck morning and evening, massaging gently until fully absorbed; for morning use, follow with broad-spectrum SPF 50+. Begin use immediately following the post-procedure cooling phase; apply as the final moisturizing step before SPF. For ongoing anti-aging maintenance, use twice daily for at least 8–12 weeks for measurable collagen-density improvements.
products.description_ru: EGF ACTIVE VITAL CREAM — регенерирующий крем (20 мл) с эпидермальным фактором роста (EGF) для восстановления кожи и антивозрастного эффекта. Повышает эластичность, уменьшает мелкие морщины и стимулирует обновление клеток.
products.specification_ru: 20 мл. Регенерирующий крем с EGF для восстановления и антивозрастного ухода.

products.name: EASYEF
products.description: EASYEF is a high-potency active-form Epidermal Growth Factor (EGF) topical formulation in a 5 g refrigerated tube, delivering sh-Oligopeptide-1 at elevated concentration to accelerate keratinocyte proliferation, dermal fibroblast activation, and post-ablative wound re-epithelialization. The unpreserved or minimally preserved, cold-stored format preserves EGF bioactivity, making it particularly effective during the critical 72-hour post-procedure inflammatory and proliferative healing phases after laser resurfacing, microneedling, or chemical peel. Indicated as a clinical recovery accelerant for post-laser, post-peel, and post-needling skin.
products.indication: Suitable for use within post-laser, microneedling, or chemical peel recovery routines that are intended to support the comfort and resilience of the skin barrier.
products.packaging: Supplied as a 5 g tube per unit, as stated in the product specification.
products.protocol: Store refrigerated (2–8°C) and use within the specified open-vial period. Apply a thin layer to cleansed post-procedure skin 1–2 times daily; begin once active exudate has ceased, typically 24–48 hours post-procedure. Apply gently without rubbing to avoid disrupting fragile neo-epithelium. Use for 5–7 days post-procedure or as directed; follow with gentle SPF once re-epithelialization is complete.
products.description_ru: EASYEF — высокоэффективная формула EGF (5 г) для направленного лечения. Идеально после лазерной процедуры, микронидлинга или химического пилинга. Ускоряет регенерацию и восстанавливает кожный барьер.
products.specification_ru: 5 г. Высокоэффективная формула EGF для направленного применения.

products.name: D-PANTHENOL CREAM [50G]
products.description: D-Panthenol Cream is a Provitamin B5 (Dexpanthenol)-rich emollient cream that converts to Pantothenic Acid in the skin, where it acts as a co-factor for acetyl-CoA synthesis essential to keratinocyte proliferation and epidermal barrier lipid production. It deeply hydrates, softens, and supports the repair of dry, cracked, or irritated skin by stimulating epithelial cell mitosis and promoting glycosaminoglycan synthesis, making it gentle enough for routine use on infants, delicate, and highly sensitive skin. Indicated for dry and sensitive skin, diaper rash, minor burns, superficial skin irritation, and general aftercare following aesthetic procedures.
products.indication: Designed for sensitive skin, infants, and general aftercare routines that aim to support skin comfort and hydration within structured daily skin-care practice.
products.packaging: Supplied as a 50 g tube per unit, as stated in the product specification.
products.protocol: Apply a thin layer to the affected skin area 1–3 times daily, gently massaging until absorbed; for infants, apply to clean, dry skin at each nappy change or as directed. For post-procedure use, apply after the acute inflammatory phase has resolved to support barrier restoration. No time-limited restriction on daily use; reduce frequency once skin comfort is achieved and maintained.
products.description_ru: D-Panthenol Cream — крем (50 г) с провитамином B5. Глубоко увлажняет и восстанавливает сухую, раздражённую или повреждённую кожу. Идеально для чувствительной кожи, детей и послепроцедурного ухода.
products.specification_ru: 50 г. Провитамин B5. Глубокое увлажнение и восстановление кожи.

products.name: Rejuvenex PDRN Cream
products.description: Rejuvenex PDRN Cream is a pharmaceutical-grade topical formulation containing PDRN (Polydeoxyribonucleotide sodium) at 1,200 ppm alongside Allantoin and Onion Extract (Allium Cepa), combining three complementary scar-remodeling and skin-repair mechanisms. PDRN activates A2A adenosine receptors to stimulate tissue regeneration and reduce fibrotic collagen deposition; Allantoin increases cell turnover and softens thickened tissue; Onion Extract inhibits fibroblast proliferation and TGF-beta activity to flatten and normalize scar architecture. Indicated for post-acne marks, surgical scars, stretch marks, and general skin texture irregularities.
products.indication: Designed for routines addressing the appearance of scars, stretch marks, and uneven skin texture, supporting consistent skin-care use over an extended period.
products.packaging: Supplied as a 10 g tube per unit, as stated in the product specification.
products.protocol: Apply a small amount to the fully epithelialized target area and massage gently twice daily (morning and evening). For scar treatment, begin once wounds are completely closed and continue for 3–6 months for optimal scar remodeling. For post-procedure skin recovery, use as the final recovery moisturizer after the acute phase. Refrigeration after opening is recommended if specified on the label.
products.description_ru: Rejuvenex PDRN Cream — фармацевтический крем от рубцов (10 г), обогащённый аллантоином и экстрактом лука. При систематическом применении осветляет рубцы, растяжки и неровности кожи.
products.specification_ru: 10 г. Крем от рубцов с аллантоином и экстрактом лука.

products.name: NOSCARNA [20g]
products.description: Noscarna is a well-regarded Korean scar gel combining Allium Cepa (onion bulb) extract — which suppresses TGF-beta-mediated fibroblast activation and reduces abnormal collagen deposition — with Heparin sodium (anticoagulant and anti-fibrotic agent that deconsticts cross-linked scar matrix) and Allantoin (keratolytic and cell-renewal promoter). The triple-active synergy addresses the primary pathological drivers of hypertrophic and keloid scarring: excess fibroblast activity, scar vascularity, and rigid collagen architecture. Indicated for both newly formed and longstanding surgical, traumatic, burn, and acne scars.
products.indication: Designed for routines that aim to soften and flatten the visible appearance of both old and newly formed scars within consistent daily skin-care programs.
products.packaging: Supplied as a 20 g tube per unit, as stated in the product specification.
products.protocol: Apply a thin layer to the fully healed scar surface and massage gently with fingertips 2–3 times daily. For optimal results, begin treatment as soon as wounds are fully closed (epithelialized) and use consistently for 3–6 months; established scars may require longer treatment durations of 6–12 months. Combine with silicone sheeting or pressure therapy for hypertrophic scars. Avoid application on open, infected, or actively bleeding wounds.
products.description_ru: Noscarna — лидирующий в Корее гель от рубцов (20 г), содержащий экстракт лука (Allium Cepa), гепарин и аллантоин. Смягчает и разглаживает старые и новые рубцы. Рекомендован дерматологами.
products.specification_ru: 20 г. Экстракт лука, гепарин, аллантоин. Ведущий корейский гель от рубцов.

products.name: BENTPLA GEL [15g]
products.description: Bentpla Gel is a topical anti-bruising, anti-inflammatory analgesic gel formulated with Heparin Sodium 400 IU/g (loosens coagulated subcutaneous blood by suppressing Thrombokinase and Prothrombin activity), Aescin 10 mg/g (anti-inflammatory and venotonic saponin from Horse Chestnut that reduces capillary permeability), and Glycol Salicylate 20 mg/g (analgesic and anti-inflammatory salicylic acid ester for pain relief). The three-mechanism combination addresses bruise resolution, edema reduction, and local pain simultaneously, making it effective for post-injection bruising in aesthetic practice, athletic contusions, sprains, and minor swelling. Fast-absorbing gel base enhances percutaneous penetration of active ingredients.
products.indication: Suitable for general use following minor bumps, sprains, or overuse, and as a general first-aid companion within routine household, travel, or sporting care.
products.packaging: Supplied as a 15 g tube per unit, as stated in the product specification.
products.protocol: Apply a thin layer of gel to the bruised, swollen, or contused area and rub gently into the skin several times daily; the fast-absorbing formula requires no occlusion. Begin use as soon as possible after the injury or post-procedure bruising appears for fastest resolution. Avoid application on open wounds, mucous membranes, or broken skin. Discontinue if skin irritation or allergic reaction develops.
products.description_ru: Bentpla Gel — противовоспалительный и анальгетический гель для местного применения (15 г). Уменьшает боль, синяки и отёки после травм, растяжений, варикоза или перегрузок. Быстро впитывается. Идеально для первой помощи, спортсменов или при проблемах с кровообращением.
products.specification_ru: 15 г. Гель с противовоспалительным и обезболивающим действием при синяках, отёках и ушибах.

products.name: Rejunera EXO-PDRN CREAM
products.description: Rejunera EXO-PDRN Cream is a premium topical recovery and anti-aging cream combining high-purity PDRN (Polydeoxyribonucleotide), which activates cellular repair via A2A adenosine receptor stimulation and upregulates collagen I and III synthesis, with Squalane — an ultra-lightweight, non-comedogenic emollient that reinforces the lipid barrier and locks in hydration without occlusive heaviness. The PDRN-Squalane combination supports both deep regenerative signaling and surface barrier protection, making this formulation particularly suited to intensive post-procedure aftercare and ongoing anti-aging maintenance. Indicated for skin recovery following laser, microneedling, chemical peel, and injectable aesthetic treatments.
products.indication: Designed for intensive daily skin-care routines and structured aftercare programs, particularly within the period following common in-office aesthetic procedures.
products.packaging: Supplied as a 30 mL container per unit, as stated in the product specification.
products.protocol: Apply to thoroughly cleansed skin as the final moisturizing step of morning and evening routine; for post-procedure use, begin once acute redness and weeping have resolved (typically 24–48 hours post-treatment). Massage gently in upward strokes until fully absorbed, then follow with SPF 50+ in the morning. Continue daily use for 4–6 weeks post-procedure for full barrier and collagen-regeneration benefit.
products.description_ru: Rejunera EXO-PDRN CREAM — крем (30 мл) с высокоочищенным PDRN для обновления кожи. Содержит PDRN и сквалан. Стимулирует интенсивную регенерацию, глубоко увлажняет и восстанавливает повреждённую кожу, особенно после эстетических процедур.
products.specification_ru: 30 мл. Высокоочищенный PDRN и сквалан для обновления, увлажнения и восстановления кожи.

products.name: ASCEplus HomeCare Sunshine Cushion PRO
products.description: ASCEplus HomeCare Sunshine Cushion PRO is a SPF50+ PA+++ sun cushion formulated with exosomes, peptides, Niacinamide, and triple Hyaluronic Acid, providing high-efficacy UV-A and UV-B photoprotection alongside active skin-conditioning agents. The exosome and peptide complex works throughout the day to support skin resilience and radiance while the Niacinamide suppresses melanin transfer for an even tone; Hyaluronic Acid delivers immediate cushion-on skin hydration. Suitable as a daily protective final step for all skin types, including post-procedure and sensitive skin requiring concurrent UV protection and active nourishment.
products.indication: - Daily sun protection - Dull and dry skin - Sensitive or stressed skin - Skin needing hydration, radiance, and protective care - Uneven tone and photoaging prevention
products.packaging: Cushion compact set containing two 12 g refills with applicator puff, total net weight 24 g.
products.protocol: Apply as the final morning skincare step over moisturizer or makeup base; press the puff gently with a patting motion for even, buildable coverage. For post-procedure skin, begin use once re-epithelialization is complete and consult with the treating physician before applying over healing tissue. Reapply every 2–3 hours as needed throughout the day, especially after perspiration, swimming, or towel contact, to maintain full SPF50+ protection.
products.description_ru: ASCEplus HomeCare Sunshine Cushion PRO — защитный солнечный кушон (12 г x 2). SPF50+ PA+++. Подходит для всех типов кожи. Защищает от УФ-излучения, увлажняет, успокаивает и придаёт коже здоровое сияние. Содержит экзосомы, пептиды, ниацинамид и гиалуроновую кислоту. Более чем кушон — это восстанавливающий санскрин с антивозрастным действием.
products.specification_ru: 12 г x 2. Кушон компакт. SPF50+ PA+++. Для всех типов кожи.

products.name: CELLEXO Bio-Cellulose Exosome Mask
products.description: CELLEXO Bio-Cellulose Exosome Mask is a treatment-grade sheet mask utilizing a bio-cellulose carrier — a bacterial nanofiber membrane that conforms tightly to facial contours for superior occlusive delivery — infused with plant-derived exosomes and triple-weight hyaluronic acid (high, medium, and low molecular weight) to deliver hydration at multiple skin depths simultaneously. The plant exosomes carry microRNA and signaling peptides that modulate inflammatory pathways, support epidermal barrier regeneration, and activate fibroblasts, distinguishing this from conventional hydrating sheet masks. Indicated for dull, dehydrated, or inflamed skin, post-procedure recovery, and loss of elasticity and radiance.
products.indication: - Dull, tired, or dehydrated skin - Loss of elasticity and early aging signs - Sensitive or irritated skin - Skin needing hydration and repair This is not a regular sheet mask, it’s a bio-cellulose exosome treatment mask with deeper penetration, better hydration, and real skin-repair benefits.
products.packaging: Retail carton of five individually sealed bio-cellulose sheet masks, each containing 30 ml of essence.
products.protocol: Cleanse the face thoroughly, apply the bio-cellulose mask and smooth firmly to ensure full skin contact across facial contours; leave undisturbed for 15–20 minutes. Remove the mask and gently pat any remaining essence into the skin until fully absorbed; do not rinse. Use 1–3 times per week for maintenance, or daily for the first week following aesthetic procedures to maximize post-treatment recovery. Follow with serum and moisturizer if desired.
products.description_ru: CELLEXO Bio-Cellulose Exosome Mask — восстанавливающая маска из биоцеллюлозы с экзосомами (30 мл x 5 масок в коробке). Содержит экзосомы растительного происхождения и тройную гиалуроновую кислоту. Глубоко увлажняет, успокаивает, повышает упругость и сияние кожи. Не обычная тканевая маска — полноценная биоцеллюлозная экзосомная маска с глубоким проникновением и реальным восстанавливающим эффектом.
products.specification_ru: 30 мл x 5 масок в коробке. Восстанавливающая биоцеллюлозная маска с экзосомами растительного происхождения и тройной HA.

products.name: CREBEAU Placenta Pearl Essence Mask
products.description: CREBEAU Placenta Pearl Essence Mask is a brightening sheet mask saturated with plant-based placenta extract, pearl extract, and peptides that work synergistically to hydrate, improve skin radiance, and support elasticity. The essence base delivers concentrated nourishment in a single 15-20 minute application, leaving the complexion visibly smoother and more luminous.
products.indication: - Dull and uneven skin tone - Fine lines and early aging signs - Dry or dehydrated skin - Skin needing nourishment and glow
products.packaging: Retail carton containing ten individually packaged sheet masks, each saturated with 25 ml of essence.
products.protocol: Apply to thoroughly cleansed skin and leave in place for 15-20 minutes. Remove the sheet and massage residual essence into the face, neck, and decollete until fully absorbed. Use 1-3 times per week as a stand-alone treatment or after in-clinic procedures.
products.description_ru: CREBEAU Placenta Pearl Essence Mask — осветляющая и омолаживающая тканевая маска (25 мл x 10 масок). Содержит экстракт плацентарного сырья растительного происхождения, пептиды и экстракт жемчуга. Увлажняет, разглаживает и улучшает сияние и эластичность кожи. Для тусклого, неровного тона, мелких морщин и обезвоженной кожи.
products.specification_ru: 25 мл x 10 масок. Осветляющая и омолаживающая тканевая маска с экстрактом растительной плаценты, пептидами и жемчугом.

products.name: SPIDER TOXIN PROGRAM
products.specification: Toxin serum 0.6g/30 pouches + Micro Needle Serum 0.9g/10 pouches
products.description: SPIDER TOXIN PROGRAM is a dual-step topical system combining a smoothing toxin serum with a bio micro-needle serum to optimize ingredient penetration and surface texture refinement. The toxin serum works to relax facial expression lines while the dissolvable micro-needle serum delivers active ingredients into the upper dermis for deep hydration and visible firming.
products.indication: Intended for the appearance of fine lines, uneven texture, and reduced elasticity, and designed for both professional in-clinic application and complementary home-care routines.
products.packaging: Program set: Toxin serum 0.6 g across 30 pouches plus Micro Needle Serum 0.9 g across 10 pouches.

Layer the micro-needle serum onto priority wrinkle areas and press gently to activate the dissolving needles. Use the toxin serum daily and the micro-needle serum 2-3 times per week for cumulative results.
products.description_ru: SPIDER TOXIN PROGRAM — двухэтапная антивозрастная программа для местного применения: сыворотка-токсин 0.6 г/30 пакетиков + сыворотка с микроиглами 0.9 г/10 пакетиков. Уменьшает морщины, улучшает текстуру и эластичность кожи. Сочетает токсиноподобную сглаживающую сыворотку с технологией биомикроигл для улучшения проникновения ингредиентов, увлажнения и регенерации.
products.specification_ru: 0.6 г/30 пакетиков. Сыворотка с микроиглами 0.9 г/10 пакетиков. Двухэтапная антивозрастная программа.

products.name: Rejuran Healer Calming Lip Balm
products.description: Rejuran Healer Calming Lip Balm is formulated with c-PDRN (Polynucleotide) derived from salmon DNA and nourishing shea butter, providing cellular repair support alongside long-lasting moisture retention for delicate lip tissue. The lightweight texture absorbs without stickiness, making it suitable for daily use and as a post-procedure lip comfort product.
products.indication: Designed for dry, sensitive, or easily chapped lips and intended for daily comfort, ongoing conditioning, and use following in-clinic lip treatments.
products.packaging: Single retail tube containing 3.7 g of lip balm with a precision applicator tip.
products.protocol: Apply a thin even layer to clean, dry lips as needed throughout the day, after eating, or immediately following in-clinic lip filler or laser treatments. Reapply generously at bedtime for overnight conditioning. No rinsing required.
products.description_ru: Rejuran Healer Calming Lip Balm — увлажняющий бальзам для губ (3.7 г) с c-PDRN и маслом ши. Для сухих и чувствительных губ. Увлажняет, восстанавливает и придаёт блеск.
products.specification_ru: 3.7 г. Увлажняющий бальзам для губ с c-PDRN и маслом ши.

products.name: Vanhalla BLEMISH Tranexamic Acid 3 Serum
products.description: Vanhalla BLEMISH Tranexamic Acid 3 Serum delivers 3% tranexamic acid alongside niacinamide and botanical brightening agents to inhibit melanin transfer, reduce post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation, and visibly even skin tone over consistent daily use. The lightweight 30 mL formula is suitable for blemish-prone complexions and areas of persistent discoloration.
products.indication: Intended for blemish-prone or marked complexions and designed for daily use on skin seeking tone uniformity, clarity, and continued comfort.
products.packaging: Single retail bottle containing 30 mL of serum with a precision dropper applicator.

products.name: Vanhalla CICA CALM MIST TONER
products.description: Vanhalla CICA CALM MIST TONER features 6% enhanced centella asiatica extract as its primary active, delivering concentrated madecassoside and asiaticoside to calm redness, support barrier integrity, and gently exfoliate sensitized skin. products.name: P198 RECORE INNER GEL (ExoNature)
products.description: P198 RECORE INNER GEL contains PSC1994-EXPG™ Panax ginseng-derived exosomes alongside lactic acid for pH maintenance, multi-weight hyaluronic acid for tissue hydration, and peptides to support elasticity and intimate skin renewal. products.name: VELATOX GF11

Follow with the soothing moisturizer to seal and calm the scalp. Perform 1-2 sessions per week for 8-12 weeks as an initial course.

products.specification_ru: 11. 10 мл x 5 vials + успокаивающий увлажнитель. Ампула для кожи головы с 11 клеточными факторами роста.

products.name: CAMELLEX Camellia Exo No.5
products.specification: Exosome Powder 100mg x 3 vials + Solvent Ampoule (PDRN+Collagen+Peptides) 6 mL x 3 vials
products.description: CAMELLEX Camellia Exo No.5 is a dual-ampoule skin booster pairing 100 mg of plant-derived camellia exosomes per vial with a 6 mL solvent ampoule containing PDRN, collagen, and peptides alongside botanical extracts. products.specification_ru: 100 мг x 3 флакона + растворитель (PDRN + коллаген + пептиды) 6 мл x 3 флакона.

products.name: LXC LACTO EXO COLLA

products.description_ru: LXC LACTO EXO COLLA — скин-бустер с экзосомами лактобацилл (порошок 100 мг x 5 флаконов + PDRN + пептиды 6 мл x 5 флаконов). Регенерирует и питает кожу. products.specification_ru: 100 мг x 5 флаконов + PDRN + пептиды 6 мл x 5 флаконов. Регенерирующий скин-бустер с растительными экзосомами.

products.name: SELASTIN TOX GF11
products.description: SELASTIN TOX GF11 is an anti-wrinkle and brightening skin booster containing Syn-Ake (a synthetic tripeptide mimicking waglerin-1 for muscle relaxation), multiple growth factors (EGF, FGF, IGF), glutathione, arbutin, vitamins C/B2/B3/B12, and adenosine in a 5 mL ready-to-inject formulation. products.description_ru: SELASTIN TOX GF11 — антивозрастной и осветляющий скин-бустер (5 мл x 5 vials). Содержит факторы роста, пептиды и антиоксидантные витамины. Ключевые ингредиенты: Syn-Ake, пептиды, EGF, FGF, IGF, глутатион, витамин C, арбутин, аденозин. Уменьшает морщины, повышает упругость, осветляет.

products.name: CURENEX SCULP
products.description: CURENEX SCULP is a poly-L-lactic acid (PLLA) collagen biostimulator supplied as 360 mg of sterile microparticle powder per vial. products.specification_ru: 360 мг/флакон. Биостимулятор коллагена на основе поли-L-молочной кислоты.

products.specification_ru: 5 мл x 5 vials. Биоревитализант. PDRN из лосося стимулирует клеточное восстановление.

products.name: CURENEX DAILY CARE SKINBOOSTER (SERUM)

products.name: CURENEX REJUVENATING CREAM

products.name: CURENEX HYDRATING CLEANSER

The mild surfactant base is designed to avoid stripping the acid mantle, leaving the skin balanced and calm after washing.

products.name: CURENEX LIPO (FACE AND BODY)
products.description: CURENEX LIPO is a phosphatidylcholine (PPC)-based lipolytic injectable formulated for both facial and body fat reduction procedures. Typical sessions require 2-4 vials for body and 0.5-2 vials for facial use; schedule treatments 4-6 weeks apart for 2-4 sessions total.

products.specification_ru: 50 мл. Лёгкий крем для осветления с экзосомами, PDRN, витаминами и пептидами.

products.name: CURENEX EYE

products.packaging: Supplied as a kit containing 4 vials x 1 g of C-TOX powder together with 30 mL of Snowpeel Activator solution.

Apply to cleansed skin and massage gently in small circular motions for 2-5 minutes to activate micro-channelling, then leave the mask on for 10-15 minutes before rinsing with lukewarm water. A course of 4-6 sessions at 2-3 week intervals is recommended; follow each session with sunscreen and avoid active retinoids for 72 hours.
products.description_ru: CURENEX SNOW PEEL — инновационная пилинговая система. 4 флакона x 1 г порошка C-TOX и 30 мл активатора Snowpeel. Одновременно удаляет ороговевшие клетки и омолаживает кожу. C-TOX порошок — очищенная гидролизованная губка. Активатор Snow Peel содержит ДНК лосося, глутатион, глюконолактон, уникально разработанный K-Derma.
products.specification_ru: 4 флакона x 1 г порошка C-TOX и 30 мл активатора Snowpeel.

products.name: CURENEX SHEER SUNSCREEN SPF
products.description: CURENEX Sheer Sunscreen delivers SPF50+ PA+++ broad-spectrum UV protection in a lightweight daily formula enriched with PDRN, peptides, and glutathione, combining reliable photoprotection with skin-conditioning and brightening actives. PDRN supports UV-induced DNA repair, glutathione provides antioxidant quenching of ROS generated by sun exposure, and the sheer finish is designed for comfortable daily wear without white cast.
products.indication: Designed for daily broad-spectrum UV protection, suitable for use on sensitive or post-procedure skin as part of a regular morning skincare routine.
products.packaging: Supplied in a 50 mL tube for daily home care sun protection use.
products.protocol: Apply as the final morning skincare step, spreading a sufficient quantity (approximately 0.5 mL for face and neck) evenly across all exposed skin areas. Reapply every 2 hours during continuous outdoor exposure, after sweating, or after towelling. Particularly recommended as daily sun protection following PDRN injectable sessions and brightening treatments to prevent UV-triggered hyperpigmentation rebound.
products.description_ru: CURENEX SHEER SUNSCREEN — солнцезащитный крем (50 мл, SPF50+ PA+++). Содержит PDRN, пептиды, глутатион. Лёгкая защита с уходом за кожей.

products.name: DERMAGEN Egensia Cream
products.description: DERMAGEN Egensia Cream is an intensive post-procedure recovery cream formulated with Centella Asiatica extract, EGF (epidermal growth factor), salmon egg extract, copper tripeptide-1, ceramide complex, and shea butter. These ingredients work synergistically to reinforce the skin barrier, support epidermal regeneration, and reduce post-laser redness and sensitivity. The combination of growth factors and barrier lipids makes it particularly suited for use after ablative and non-ablative laser procedures.
products.indication: Designed to soothe and condition post-laser skin and to support the skin barrier following professional aesthetic procedures in daily care routines.
products.packaging: Supplied in a 50 g tube for daily home care use after aesthetic procedures.
products.protocol: For home and clinic use following laser or aesthetic procedures. Apply a thin layer to thoroughly cleansed skin twice daily, morning and evening, gently pressing in until fully absorbed. Begin application immediately after the procedure and continue throughout the recovery period. Use for a minimum of 2 weeks post-treatment, or as directed by the practitioner.
products.description_ru: DERMAGEN Egensia Cream — интенсивный восстанавливающий крем (50 г, туба) с экстрактом центеллы азиатской, EGF, экстрактом икры лосося, медным трипептидом-1, церамидом и маслом ши. Успокаивает и восстанавливает кожу после лазерных процедур. Укрепляет барьер кожи и глубоко увлажняет.
products.specification_ru: 50 г, туба. Центелла азиатская, EGF, икра лосося, медный трипептид-1, церамид, масло ши.

products.name: DR.PICOS EGENCICA CREAM [60g]
products.description: Dr. PICOS Egencica Cream is a 60 g post-dermal care cream developed for sensitive and reactive skin following aesthetic procedures. The formulation delivers targeted comfort, barrier-supportive hydration, and a conditioning effect suited to delicate facial zones. It is designed to be gentle enough for skin in an active recovery phase while providing meaningful moisture retention.
products.indication: Designed to support skin comfort, hydration, and barrier-focused care after aesthetic procedures, suitable for sensitive and reactive skin types.
products.packaging: Supplied in a 60 g tube for daily home and clinic-recommended post-procedure care use.
products.protocol: For home and clinic use. Apply a thin layer to cleansed, dried skin twice daily after aesthetic procedures, gently patting in until absorbed. Continue throughout the full post-procedure recovery period. Adjust frequency based on skin sensitivity and practitioner guidance.
products.description_ru: Dr. PICOS EGENCICA CREAM — крем для послепроцедурного ухода (60 г). Успокаивает чувствительную и обработанную кожу. Поддерживает увлажнённость, восстановление барьера и общий комфорт кожи после эстетических процедур.
products.specification_ru: 60 г. Крем для послепроцедурного ухода за чувствительной кожей.

products.name: DR.Picos RMV Repair Cream [200g]
products.description: Dr. Picos RMV Repair Cream is a rich 200 g barrier-replenishing daily cream designed to support the skin's moisture balance and aid recovery after professional aesthetic treatments. Its formulation provides a calming, conditioning feel suited to skin under physiological stress, including post-treatment dryness, sensitivity, and compromised barrier function. The large-format tube makes it practical for use across both face and body.
products.indication: Intended for use during skin recovery and daily care, designed to help calm, condition, and comfort irritated or stressed facial and body skin.
products.packaging: Supplied in a 200 g tube for daily home use across face and body care routines.
products.protocol: For daily home use. Apply liberally to cleansed skin morning and evening, focusing on dry or recovering areas, and massage gently in upward motions until fully absorbed. May be applied to both face and body. Continue throughout the recovery period as directed by the treating practitioner.
products.description_ru: Dr. Picos RMV Repair Cream — насыщенный восстанавливающий крем (200 г). Укрепляет барьер кожи и поддерживает регенерацию. Улучшает удержание влаги, успокаивает раздражённую кожу и способствует её здоровому виду в процессе восстановления.
products.specification_ru: 200 г. Насыщенный крем для восстановления барьера кожи.

products.name: DR.Picos Ureanol Cream [200g]
products.description: Dr. Picos Ureanol Cream is a 200 g intensive moisturizing cream formulated with urea as its principal keratolytic and humectant active, targeting very dry, rough, and thickened skin areas on the body. Urea binds water within the stratum corneum, softens thickened epidermis through keratolytic action, and supports the natural moisture factor of the skin surface. The formulation is particularly effective on elbows, heels, knees, and chronically dry patches.
products.indication: Suitable for body and problem-area care, designed to soften skin and support hydration and barrier-focused conditioning across dry, rough zones.
products.packaging: Supplied in a 200 g tube for daily home use across body and problem-area care routines.
products.protocol: For daily home use on body and problem areas. Apply an appropriate amount to affected zones once or twice daily and massage thoroughly until fully absorbed. For very thickened or fissured areas, apply under occlusion overnight for enhanced penetration. Continue regularly for at least 4 weeks for optimal keratolytic benefit.
products.description_ru: Dr. Picos Ureanol Cream — интенсивный увлажняющий крем (200 г) для очень сухой, грубой и утолщённой кожи. Смягчает и разглаживает кожу, поддерживает увлажнение и защиту барьера. Идеально для тела и проблемных зон.
products.specification_ru: 200 г. Интенсивный увлажняющий крем для очень сухой и грубой кожи.

products.name: CINDELRIA TONE-UP SUN CREAM SPF50+
products.description: Cindelria Tone-Up Sun Cream is a brightening tinted sunscreen with SPF50+ PA++++ broad-spectrum UV protection, formulated with Centella Asiatica extract, aloe vera, and a soft-focus pigment complex to instantly unify and brighten the complexion. The formula provides both physical UV filtration via titanium dioxide and chemical UV filters while delivering a natural pink-tinted finish that reduces the appearance of dullness. It is designed as the final step of the morning skincare routine.
products.indication: Designed for daily broad-spectrum UV protection together with a brightened complexion, suitable for use as a finishing step in the morning routine.
products.packaging: 1x Pdrénza Serum 50ml 1x Pdrénza Cream 50ml Free Samples Collagen Serum 3ml, Pdrénza Serum 3ml, Pdrénza Cream 3ml, Mela-Dual Day Cream 3ml, Mela-Dual Night Cream 3ml.

Reapply approximately every two hours during prolonged outdoor or sun exposure, or after sweating and towelling.
products.description_ru: Cindelria Tone-Up Sun Cream — многофункциональный санскрин с тонирующим эффектом (40 мл, SPF50+ PA++++). Обеспечивает высокую UV-защиту, осветляет тон кожи с натуральным розовым сиянием, разглаживает мелкие морщины и создаёт стойкое свежее покрытие.
products.specification_ru: 40 мл. Многофункциональный санскрин с тонирующим эффектом. SPF50+ PA++++.

products.name: DERMAGEN Soothing mask
products.description: DERMAGEN Soothing Mask is a post-procedure sheet mask formulated with glycerin, panthenol, allantoin, aloe barbadensis leaf juice powder, hydrolyzed collagen, and sodium hyaluronate to rapidly soothe, hydrate, and protect skin after laser or aesthetic procedures. The ingredients create a moist recovery environment that reduces redness, swelling, and irritation, while the collagen and hyaluronate complex supports moisture retention in recovering epidermis. Supplied as 10 individually packed sheets at 23 g per sheet.
products.indication: Designed to support skin hydration and refreshment after laser and aesthetic procedures, suitable for sensitive skin during recovery routines.
products.packaging: Supplied as 10 sheets per box, each sheet weighing 23 g (0.81 oz) for individual single-use application.
products.protocol: For home or clinic use following laser or aesthetic procedures. Apply one sheet to thoroughly cleansed skin and leave in place for 15 to 20 minutes, then remove and gently pat any remaining essence into the skin until absorbed. Follow with a suitable recovery cream. Use 2 to 3 times per week during the post-procedure recovery period.
products.description_ru: DERMAGEN Soothing Mask — успокаивающая маска (10 шт.), 1 маска/23 г. Содержит гидролизованный коллаген, аллантоин, пантенол. Обеспечивает мгновенное облегчение после лазерных процедур. Ускоряет восстановление кожи, увлажняет и освежает.
products.specification_ru: 23 г на маску. Гидролизованный коллаген, аллантоин, пантенол. Успокаивающая маска после лазерных процедур.

products.name: DERMAGEN Well-spot Hydrocolloid
products.description: DERMAGEN Well-spot Hydrocolloid is an ultra-thin, hypoallergenic hydrocolloid spot patch that creates a moist wound-healing environment over active blemishes, post-extraction spots, and minor superficial wounds. The hydrocolloid matrix absorbs excess exudate and sebum, promotes faster epidermal closure, and provides a physical barrier against secondary contamination and picking. Each patch measures approximately 1.2 cm diameter and is discreet enough for daytime or overnight wear.
products.indication: Suitable for daily care of pimples, blemishes, and post-procedure spots, intended to support a clean, protected environment over targeted areas.
products.packaging: Supplied as 15 spots per sheet with 4 sheets per pack for daily home care use.
products.protocol: For daily home use. Apply one patch to clean, thoroughly dry skin directly over the target blemish or spot, pressing gently at the edges to ensure full adhesion. Leave in place until the patch turns opaque (indicating exudate absorption), then replace with a fresh patch. Repeat until the lesion has resolved. May be worn under makeup.

products.name: DERMAGEN White Sun Cream
products.description: DERMAGEN White Sun Cream is a triple-function SPF50+ PA++++ sunscreen formulated with glutathione, Centella Asiatica extract, niacinamide, adenosine, ethylhexyl triazone, and titanium dioxide to deliver simultaneous broad-spectrum UV protection, melanin-inhibiting brightening action, and smoothing anti-aging care. Niacinamide suppresses melanosome transfer to keratinocytes, glutathione further inhibits tyrosinase, and Centella Asiatica supports barrier integrity in post-procedure skin. Suitable as the final morning step for sensitive and post-laser complexions.
products.indication: Designed for daily UV protection together with brightening and smoothing benefits, suitable for sensitive and post-procedure skin in morning routines.
products.packaging: Supplied in a 50 g tube for daily home use sun protection and brightening care routines.
products.protocol: For daily home use. Apply an even layer to thoroughly cleansed and moisturized skin as the closing step of the morning routine. Reapply approximately every two hours during prolonged sun exposure, after sweating, or after towelling. Use consistently as part of a daily brightening maintenance protocol.
products.description_ru: DERMAGEN White Sun Cream — тройной функциональный солнцезащитный крем (50 г, туба). Содержит глутатион, экстракт центеллы азиатской, ниацинамид, аденозин, этилгексил триазон, диоксид титана. Осветляет, разглаживает морщины. Защищает чувствительную послепроцедурную кожу от UV. SPF50+ PA++++.
products.specification_ru: 50 г, туба. Глутатион, центелла азиатская, ниацинамид, аденозин, SPF50+ PA++++.

products.name: DERMAGEN Urea Cream
products.description: DERMAGEN Urea Cream is a 100 g keratolytic emollient cream with urea as its key active ingredient, supplemented with squalane and tocopheryl acetate. Urea at its working concentration loosens corneocyte cohesion to exfoliate dry, thickened epidermis, binds water within the stratum corneum, and reduces itch by desensitizing C-fibre nerve endings. The squalane component reinforces the lipid barrier while tocopheryl acetate provides antioxidant protection for compromised skin.
products.indication: Designed for deep hydration of elbows, heels, knees, and overwashed hands prone to cracking, intended to support softening and conditioning of rough skin.
products.packaging: Supplied in a 100 g tube for daily home care use across rough body and problem-area routines.
products.protocol: For daily home use on rough body areas. Apply an appropriate amount to affected zones once or twice daily, massaging thoroughly into the skin until fully absorbed. For heavily thickened or fissured skin on heels and elbows, apply under light occlusion overnight for enhanced keratolytic effect. Consistent daily use over 4 to 6 weeks is recommended for optimal results.

products.specification_ru: 100 г, туба. Мочевина (100 000 ppm), D-пантенол, токоферол, сквалан.

products.name: DERMAGEN RM Repair Cream
products.description: DERMAGEN RM Repair Cream is a 200 g daily moisturizing barrier-restoration cream developed to support post-laser and post-procedure recovery and maintain optimal epidermal hydration. The formulation delivers replenishing, conditioning care to compromised facial skin, helping to restore moisture balance and comfort during the active healing phase. Its generous format supports both home use and clinic-dispensed post-treatment protocols.

products.packaging: Supplied in a 200 g tube for daily home and clinic-recommended post-procedure care routines.
products.protocol: For home and clinic use. Apply a thin even layer to thoroughly cleansed skin morning and evening, massaging gently across the face and neck until fully absorbed. Begin use immediately following in-clinic procedures and continue throughout the recovery period, or as directed by the treating practitioner.
products.description_ru: DERMAGEN RM Repair Cream — ежедневный увлажняющий крем (200 г, туба) для восстановления кожи после лазерных процедур. Восполняет питательные вещества и укрепляет барьер влаги для здоровой и сияющей кожи.
products.specification_ru: 200 г, туба. Ежедневный увлажняющий крем для послепроцедурного восстановления кожи.

products.name: DERMAGEN Scargel
products.description: DERMAGEN Scargel is a transparent silicone-based gel dressing in a 15 g tube that forms a thin, breathable, semi-occlusive film over healing scar tissue. The silicone matrix maintains an optimal moisture balance at the scar surface, moderates collagen synthesis to help flatten hypertrophic and keloid scars, and protects the area from mechanical trauma. Regular use softens scar texture and reduces redness, firmness, and elevation over time.
products.indication: Designed to help support the appearance and flattening of raised post-surgical and post-trauma scars during long-term daily home care routines.
products.packaging: Supplied in a 15 g tube for daily home care use across targeted scar areas.

May be used in conjunction with pressure garments.

products.name: DERMAGEN Centellase Ointment
products.description: DERMAGEN Centellase Ointment is a 50 g quasi-drug topical ointment based on Centella Asiatica extract (centellase), indicated for the supportive care of superficial wounds and skin ulcers. Centellase stimulates fibroblast proliferation, promotes collagen synthesis, and improves wound epithelialization, supporting faster and more organized tissue repair. The ointment base provides a semi-occlusive barrier that maintains wound moisture and shields from external contamination.
products.indication: Designed to support the healing care of wounds and skin ulcers, intended for use as directed on the packaging or by a qualified healthcare professional.
products.packaging: Supplied in a 50 g tube as a quasi-drug wound treatment ointment for daily home or clinic use.
products.protocol: For home and clinic use. Cleanse the wound or affected area gently and pat dry, then apply a thin layer of ointment directly to the wound surface once or twice daily, or as directed by the packaging instructions or a qualified healthcare professional. Cover with an appropriate non-adherent dressing if required. Continue use until the wound has fully re-epithelialized.
products.description_ru: DERMAGEN Centellase Ointment — лекарственная мазь для лечения ран (50 г, туба). Поддерживает заживление ран и кожных язв.
products.specification_ru: 50 г, туба. Мазь для лечения ран. Поддерживает заживление ран и кожных язв.

products.name: DERMAGEN Lunatox
products.description: DERMAGEN Lunatox is a 50 g brightening cream formulated with 5% niacinamide, tranexamic acid, glutathione, hyaluronic acid, and alpha-lipoic acid to target melanin overproduction and uneven skin tone. Niacinamide inhibits melanosome transfer to keratinocytes, tranexamic acid blocks the plasmin-mediated activation of arachidonic acid in the melanin synthesis pathway, and glutathione exerts a dual inhibitory effect on tyrosinase activity. The hyaluronic acid base supports sustained epidermal hydration during daily brightening use.

products.packaging: Supplied in a 50 g tube for daily home care use across brightening-focused routines.

Apply a thin layer to thoroughly cleansed skin morning and evening, focusing on areas of uneven tone, hyperpigmentation, or dark spots, then gently pat in until fully absorbed before applying sunscreen or the next care step. Consistent daily use over 4 to 8 weeks is recommended for visible brightening results. Pair with SPF50+ sun protection every morning.
products.description_ru: DERMAGEN Lunatox — осветляющий антивозрастной крем (50 г, туба) против пигментации, мелазмы и неровного тона кожи. Содержит транексамовую кислоту, ниацинамид, аденозин, глутатион, гиалуронат натрия, тиоктовую кислоту, аскорбиновую кислоту.
products.specification_ru: 50 г, туба. Осветляющий антивозрастной крем от пигментации и мелазмы.

products.name: DERMAGEN Cicarown Cream
products.description: DERMAGEN Cicarown Cream is a 50 g cooling and hydration cream formulated with Centella Asiatica extract, aloe vera extract, shea butter, ceramide complex, EGF, FGF, tocopherol, and hyaluronic acid. The combination of growth factors (EGF and FGF) supports epidermal renewal, while ceramides rebuild the intercellular lipid barrier, and aloe vera with Centella Asiatica provide immediate anti-inflammatory and soothing effects. The formulation is designed for instant cooling relief on stressed, irritated, or post-procedure skin.

products.packaging: Supplied in a 50 g tube for daily home care use across cooling and hydration-focused routines.

products.description_ru: DERMAGEN Cicarown Cream — успокаивающий крем (50 г, туба) с экстрактом центеллы азиатской, экстрактом алоэ вера, маслом ши, церамидным комплексом, EGF, FGF, витамином E (токоферол), гиалуроновой кислотой. Мгновенно охлаждает и увлажняет.

products.name: DERMAGEN Bichaeahn Pore Toning Cream
products.description: DERMAGEN Bichaeahn Pore Toning Cream is an 80 g tannin-complex targeted cream formulated with Copper Tripeptide-1, Hamamelis Virginiana (witch hazel) extract, glutathione, niacinamide, and Hippophae Rhamnoides (sea buckthorn) fruit water to refine the appearance of enlarged pores and support a brighter, more even-toned complexion. Witch hazel tannins act as an astringent to temporarily tighten pore walls, while copper tripeptide-1 promotes collagen synthesis to structurally firm the perifolicular dermis over time. Niacinamide and glutathione address surface tone unevenness and inhibit melanin transfer.

products.packaging: Supplied in an 80 g tube for daily or in-clinic professional dispensing use.

Consistent use over 4 to 8 weeks is recommended for pore-toning results.

Визуально сужает расширенные поры чувствительной кожи. Глутатион и ниацинамид обеспечивают антиоксидантное, осветляющее и антивозрастное действие.
products.specification_ru: 80 г, туба. Медный трипептид-1, гамамелис, таниновый комплекс, глутатион, ниацинамид.

products.name: DERMAGEN Cellsia Post-laser regenerating cream (60g)
products.description: DERMAGEN Cellsia Post-Laser Regenerating Cream (60 g) is a specialist recovery cream formulated with EGF, FGF, ceramide complex, copper tripeptide-1, and shea butter to support rapid barrier restoration and epidermal regeneration following ablative or non-ablative laser procedures. products.specification_ru: 60 г, туба. Стволовые клетки пуповины, центелла азиатская, EGF, икра лосося, медный трипептид-1.

Designed for high-volume professional environments, the 500 g tube provides sufficient product for multi-patient protocols or extended clinic use. Growth factors support cellular renewal, ceramides rebuild the intercellular lipid matrix, and the anti-inflammatory actives minimize post-procedure erythema and discomfort.

products.description_ru: DERMAGEN Cellsia — послелазерный регенерирующий крем (500 г, туба). Аналогичный состав, больший объём.

products.name: DERMAGEN EZCera Cream
products.description: DERMAGEN EZCera Cream is a 200 g medical depigmenting cream formulated with 4% hydroquinone as the principal melanin-suppressing agent. The large-format tube supports both supervised in-clinic and home maintenance use.
products.indication: • Melasma (chloasma) • Freckles • Post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation • Age spots / sun spots • Uneven skin tone due to excess melanin

Consult a practitioner before extended use.

products.specification_ru: 200 г, туба. Увлажняющий крем для восстановления барьера. Ежедневный послепроцедурный уход.

products.name: EXOSIA Skin Booster Part 1

products.name: GTM EXOMELA
products.specification: EXO Signal 1000 Powder 180mg + Mela Vital Solution 5 mL (5 sets per box)

products.name: GTM PDRN MASK for face and neck
